page.overview:
Who is Lightblueincible?

Donald Ferguson (presumed attempted victim)

Nolan Grayson (father) Debbie Grayson (mother)

Lightblueincible is a minor antagonist in the third season of the series.

Lightblueincible is an evil variant of the main Invincible, coming from another universe. He was one of the variants to be recruited by Angstrom Levy to join the multiversal assault, but Lightblueincible was killed under unknown circumstances, and after the war, his corpse was later collected by the G.D.A. to be converted into a ReAniman.
